name: Nava Limited
summary: Nava Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in ferroalloy manufacturing, energy, mining, agribusiness, and operation and maintenance services in India, Zambia, the United States, Hong Kong, Japan, the United Arab Emirates, and internationally. It operates through Ferro Alloys, Energy, Mining, and Other segments. The company operates 150 MW and 114 MW coal power plants in Paloncha, Telangana; 150 MW coal power plant in Dhenkanal, Odisha; 20 MW coal/bagasse power plant in Dharmavaram, Andhra Pradesh; and 300 MW power plant in Zambia.
